title: Deep Learning for Biopsy-Free Subtyping of Basal Cell Carcinoma from Dermatoscopic Images
abstract: arXiv:2609.07180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC) is the most common type of skin cancer, accounting for nearly 80% of skin cancer di- agnoses. Its optimal clinical management is guided by the distinct histopathologic subtype, with aggressive variants requiring more drastic measures. In current clinical practice, subtyping relies on skin biopsies, a procedure both costly and invasive. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary investigation into using deep learning for BCC subtyping, solely from a single dermatoscopic image of the lesion. Given the limited data at our disposal, we employ pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs), a state-of-the-art family of models highly effective for challenging downstream tasks with limited labeled data. translated_title: 基于皮肤镜图像的深度学习无活检基底细胞癌亚型分类
translated_abstract: 基底细胞癌（BCC）是最常见的皮肤癌类型，约占皮肤癌确诊病例的80%。其最佳临床管理方案取决于不同的组织病理学亚型，其中侵袭性亚型需要更积极的治疗措施。在目前的临床实践中，亚型分类依赖于皮肤活检，这一过程既昂贵又具有侵入性。在本文中，我们初步探索了利用深度学习仅从单张病变皮肤镜图像进行基底细胞癌亚型分类。鉴于我们可获得的数据有限，我们采用了预训练视觉Transformer（ViT），这是一类最先进的模型，在标注数据有限的具有挑战性的下游任务中表现出色。通过重复分层k折交叉验证，我们证明了ViT能够取得优于标准CNN基线模型的性能（在包含1271张不同基底细胞癌亚型皮肤镜图像的数据集上AUC达到0.784）。
tldr: 该研究证明预训练视觉Transformer（ViT）可仅凭单张皮肤镜图像对基底细胞癌进行无活检亚型分类，在1271张图像的数据集上达到AUC 0.784，性能优于标准CNN基线模型。
